players.bio: Albert George Eames (born 20 December 2005) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Watford.
Alessio Dionisi (born 1 April 1980) is an Italian professional football coach and former player who is currently the head coach of EFL Championship club Watford.
Amin Nabizada is a professional footballer who plays for the EFL Championship club Watford as a forward. Born in England, he plays for the Afghanistan national team.

Daniel Bachmann is an Austrian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford. Bachmann began his professional career with Stoke City in 2011. During his time at Stoke, he gained first-team experience by going out on loan to Wrexham, Ross County and Bury. Bachmann began his career with Stoke City in 2011.
Edouard "Edo" Kayembe (born 3 June 1998) is a Congolese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford and the DR Congo national team.

Edoardo Bove (born 16 May 2002) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder. Early life Edoardo Bove was born in Rome. Bove's paternal branch of his family is originally from Naples, while his maternal branch is also made up of people of German origin. Bove grew up in the quartiere of Appio-Latino, and studied at the Massimo Institute in Rome's neighborhood EUR.
Federico Ravaglia (born 11 November 1999) is an Italian professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Watford.

Hector Matthew Kyprianou (born 27 May 2001) is a professional footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in England, he has represented Cyprus at under-19 and under-21 level.
Iker Bravo Solanilla (born 13 January 2005) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford.

Imrân Louza is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Super League Greece club Panathinaikos. Club career Louza joined the youth academy of FC Nantes in 2006 from Etoile du Cens, and was captain of several youth categories in the club. He made his professional debut with Nantes in a 4–1 Coupe de France win over LB Châteauroux on 4 January 2019, and scored in his debut.
Jack Alexander Grieves (born 5 December 2004) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford.

Jeremy Mpobi Ngakia (born 7 September 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Watford. Career Born in Deptford, south London, Ngakia was initially involved in the academy at Chelsea, before joining West Ham United at the age of 14.

Jordan Bhekithemba Zemura (born 14 November 1999) is a professional footballer who plays as a left-back for Watford on loan from Serie A club Udinese. Born in England, Zemura represents the Zimbabwe national team. Early life Zemura went to the Oasis Academy Isle of Sheppey for secondary school and went on to study Sport Science at Canterbury University.

Kévin Keben Biakolo (born 26 January 2004) is a Cameroonian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in Bertoua, Cameroon, Keben moved to France at the age of 2 and at 5 started playing football at Toulouse Montaudran. At the age of 10, he joined the youth academy of Toulouse and started working his way up their youth sides.

Kwadwo Kyeremeh Baah is a German professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for EFL Championship club Watford. Having played for Germany internationally at youth level, He has also represented the England U18 national team.
Luca Tange Kjerrumgaard (born 9 February 2003) is a Danish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford.

Mamadou Doumbia (born 18 February 2006) is a Malian professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Watford and the Mali national team. Doumbia signed for English club Watford in February 2024, on a six-year contract, and officially joined on 1 July 2024.
Marc Joel Bola (born 9 December 1997) is an English professional footballer who plays as a left back for EFL Championship club Watford.
Martín Ismael Payero (born 11 September 1998) is an Argentinian professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford.

Mattie William Pollock (born 28 September 2001) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Watford. Pollock was the product of the youth academies of Middlesbrough and Leeds United before joining Grimsby Town's academy in 2018.

Michail Gregory Antonio is a professional footballer and pundit who plays as a forward. He is currently a free agent having been released by West Ham United in 2025. Antonio began his career at non-League club Tooting & Mitcham United before signing with Reading of the Championship in 2008.

Myron Boadu is a Dutch professional footballer who plays as a striker for Eredivisie club PSV. Born in Amsterdam, Netherlands, Boadu is of Ghanaian descent. He joined the AZ academy in 2013. In 2018 he made his competitive debut for the club in an Eredivisie match against PEC Zwolle.
Nikoloz Chikovani is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a winger for Watford.

Omar Haktab Traoré (born 4 February 1998) is a German professional footballer who plays as a right-back for EFL Championship club Watford. Career Traoré signed for KFC Uerdingen 05 on a three-year contract in summer 2020. He signed for VfL Osnabrück on a two-year contract in summer 2021. Personal life Born in Germany, Traoré is of Togolese descent.
Othmane Maamma (born 6 October 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a forward for Watford. Born in France, he represents Morocco at youth international level.

Rocco Vata (born 18 April 2005) is a professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL Championship club Watford. Born in Scotland, he is a youth international for Ireland. Born in Glasgow, Vata followed in the footsteps of his father, former professional footballer and Celtic player Rudi Vata by joining Celtic at the age of seven.
Soumaïla Coulibaly (born 14 October 2003) is a French professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Watford, on loan from Ligue 1 club Strasbourg.
Stephy Alvaro Mavididi (born 31 May 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a forward or winger for EFL Championship club Watford, on loan from Leicester City.
